title: Relationship of Systemic Cytokine Concentrations to Cognitive Function over Two Years in Women with Early Stage Breast Cancer
notes: Longitudinal cohort of 75 women with early-stage breast cancer (stages I-IIIA), assessed 5 times over 2 years (pre-chemo through 2yr post-chemo). NO healthy control group. 17-plex cytokine panel (IL-1beta, IL-2, IL-4, IL-5, IL-6, IL-7, IL-8, IL-10, IL-12, IL-13, IL-17, G-CSF, GM-CSF, IFN-gamma, MCP-1, MIP-1beta, TNF-alpha). Cognitive assessment: CNS Vital Signs (CNSVS) computerized battery with domains: psychomotor speed, complex attention, reaction time, cognitive flexibility, executive function, composite memory, verbal memory, visual memory. Backward AIC model selection used — HIGH risk of overfitting and multiple testing (17 cytokines x 7+ domains x 5 timepoints, no correction). Key findings: TNF-alpha and MCP-1 inversely associated with psychomotor speed at 2yr; MCP-1 inversely associated with complex attention at 2yr. Cytokine patterns changed over time with 3 distinct trajectories. NOTE: 79% received radiation, 44% on hormonal therapy by T5. Majority received TAC chemotherapy.
effect_size_notes: Betas are from backward AIC regression of log-transformed cytokine concentrations to CNSVS standard scores (mean=100, SD=15). Converted t-values to partial_r via t/sqrt(t^2+df), then to d via 2r/sqrt(1-r^2). N at T5 estimated at ~55 (75 enrolled minus attrition). These are partial/adjusted effects. df estimated from N - predictors - 1.

cytokine_data.IL6_trajectory: increased during chemo then decreased below baseline
cytokine_data.MCP1_trajectory: increased during chemo, still elevated at 2yr relative to baseline

cognitive_instrument: CNS Vital Signs (CNSVS) computerized neurocognitive battery

extraction_decisions.T5_selected: Used T5 (2-year) results as most relevant for long-term survivorship effects and least confounded by acute treatment effects
extraction_decisions.TNF_selected_for_OIC: TNF-alpha is prototypical OIC component; selected over MCP-1 for ER_OIC_PROCSPEED to avoid double-counting within same study/model
extraction_decisions.N_estimate: N at T5 estimated at 55 based on typical 27% 2-year attrition from N=75; paper does not report exact N at each timepoint
